title: Risseisha beats Kyoei at Koshien and advances to third round for first time in three years
summary: Starter Kimura threw a complete game of 167 pitches and the offense hit extra-base hits to come back and win 6-2.

title: Chiben Wakayama beats Yashiro 2-1 and advances at Koshien
summary: Starter Waki pitched six scoreless innings and the team withstood the comeback attempt to earn its first win in the tournament since 2021.

title: Typhoon No. 15 makes landfall in Ibaraki for the first time and moves westward
summary: With an unusual trajectory from the east, it caused minor injuries and event cancellations, while authorities urge watching for rain, flooding and storm surges in the west.

title: Hanshin beats the Giants and takes sole possession of first place in the Central League
summary: In the professional baseball games on the 11th, Hanshin hit home runs and dominated the showdown for the top spot; Chunichi also beat DeNA.

title: Recovery and aid efforts continue two weeks after the Kumamoto earthquake
summary: Emergency routes are reopening and support is expanding, including mobile laundries, psychological care for children, and government assistance for victims.

title: It was acknowledged that re-entry was allowed to the Aeon shopping center before the explosion that left seven dead
summary: Aeon admitted that it authorized the temporary entry of evacuees after the earthquake, while authorities remembered the victims of the accident.

title: Mie defeats Matsusho Gakuen and returns to the third round of Koshien after five years
summary: Mie scored runs steadily and withstood Matsusho's comeback attempt; one of their second basemen left due to cramps.

title: Japan's H3 rocket No. 9 places an operational satellite into orbit
summary: The successful mission, carried out at Tanegashima, is the first to place a practical satellite into orbit after the previous failure; JAXA acknowledged unprecedented tension.

title: Sony and TSMC will manufacture next-generation image sensors in Kumamoto
summary: They will create a joint venture and plan to begin mass production in 2029 at a new plant with an investment of nearly one trillion yen.

title: Families remember the victims of the JAL accident with lanterns 41 years after the tragedy
summary: On the anniversary of the crash, the mourners held a light offering near the site and prayed for aviation safety.

title: The Awa Odori festival kicks off in Tokushima with dance, anime, and calls to observe the rules
summary: The traditional summer dance opened with renowned dancers, collaborations with animated characters, and warnings about etiquette when taking photos and recording.

title: Turkey's Parliament approves a peace law with the PKK that opens the door to an amnesty
summary: The measure provides legal benefits for members of the Kurdish militia and seeks to promote a reconciliation process.

title: Iran strengthens its military leadership with hardline appointments amid tensions with the U.S.
summary: The appointments in defense and security are seen as a consolidation of Tehran's hostile stance toward Washington.

title: Outrage in Australia over prime minister's comment about a melon gifted by Japan's leader
summary: The opposition demands an apology after the remarks, considered sexual in nature, about the melon sent by Japan's prime minister.

title: Tokyo's Hanzomon subway line resumes service after removing asbestos-containing material
summary: The cleanup of asbestos-containing frayed material found at Hanzomon Station kept the line suspended for 14 hours.

title: Kumamoto earthquake: 392 victims and 3,700 evacuees reported
summary: Authorities published the names of newly confirmed deaths and adjusted the number of evacuees in shelters after an actual count.

title: Ohtani gets two hits against the Royals despite discomfort in his left knee
summary: On the same day in the Major Leagues, Senga earned his first save and Matsui picked up his third win.

title: Recovery initiatives advance after the Noto earthquake
summary: A sumo stable holds a training camp to support reconstruction, while a damaged amusement park prepares new attractions for its 60th anniversary.
